reference_sql:
SELECT month, eur_per_unit,
  eur_per_unit - LAG(eur_per_unit) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS rate_change
FROM fx_rates_monthly
alternatives:
SELECT f.month, f.eur_per_unit,
  f.eur_per_unit - (SELECT p.eur_per_unit FROM fx_rates_monthly p
    WHERE p.currency = f.currency
      AND p.month = (SELECT MAX(p2.month) FROM fx_rates_monthly p2 WHERE p2.currency = f.currency AND p2.month < f.month)) AS rate_change
FROM fx_rates_monthly f

SELECT month, eur_per_unit,
  eur_per_unit - LAG(eur_per_unit, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY month) AS rate_change
FROM fx_rates_monthly

other_way.sql:
SELECT f.month, f.eur_per_unit,
  f.eur_per_unit - (SELECT p.eur_per_unit FROM fx_rates_monthly p
    WHERE p.currency = f.currency
      AND p.month = (SELECT MAX(p2.month) FROM fx_rates_monthly p2 WHERE p2.currency = f.currency AND p2.month < f.month)) AS rate_change
FROM fx_rates_monthly f
other_way.tradeoff: Looking up the latest earlier month's rate with subqueries works anywhere, but nests two subqueries where LAG takes one call.
